rimehorn: A rimehorn: a great shaggy ice-age woolly mammoth built of frost and pale blue-white fur, with a high domed skull, small ears, a long shaggy coat hanging in heavy curtains, and TWO ENORMOUS CURVED IVORY TUSKS sweeping forward and inward. Glacier-blue eyes. Standing four-square in full side-on profile, whole body opaque and solid. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
japanesewolf: A Japanese wolf, the small extinct Honshu wolf: noticeably SMALLER AND SHORTER-LEGGED than a grey wolf, about the size of a large dog, with a broad blunt head, short erect ears, a short bushy tail, and a coarse tan-grey coat with a paler cream underside. Standing alert in full side profile, solid unbroken body. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
bluebuck: A bluebuck, the extinct South African antelope: a slender antelope with a distinctive BLUISH-GREY COAT, a paler underside, a long neck, and TWO LONG BACKWARD-SWEEPING RINGED HORNS rising in a shallow curve. Slim dark legs, a white muzzle patch. Standing in full side profile, whole body solid and opaque. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
damagazelle: A dama gazelle: a tall long-necked gazelle, WHITE over most of the body with a rich chestnut-brown neck and upper back, a white head with a small dark nose patch, and short S-CURVED RINGED HORNS that hook backward then forward at the tips. Long slender white legs. Standing in side profile, body solid throughout. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
eaglet: A downy eaglet chick sitting in a stick nest: a plump fluffy white-grey down-covered baby eagle with an oversized dark hooked beak, large dark eyes, and stubby half-grown wings. THE CHEST AND BODY ARE ONE SOLID MASS OF PALE DOWN with no gaps or holes in it. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
parr: A salmon parr, a young river salmon: a slim streamlined fish with a row of DARK OVAL PARR MARKS along each flank, small red spots between them, a speckled olive-brown back, silver belly, and a small adipose fin. Shown in full side profile, body solid and unbroken. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
tropicbird: A red-billed tropicbird in flight: a slender white seabird with a heavy CORAL-RED BILL, a black eye-stripe, fine black barring across the back, black outer primaries, and TWO ENORMOUSLY LONG WHITE TAIL STREAMERS trailing far behind. Wings spread wide, body solid white throughout. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
emperorpenguin: An emperor penguin standing upright: a very large penguin with a blue-grey back, a solid BLACK HEAD, a broad WHITE BELLY that runs unbroken from throat to feet, and bright ORANGE-YELLOW EAR PATCHES fading down the neck into pale lemon on the upper chest. THE WHITE BELLY IS ONE SOLID UNBROKEN AREA with no gaps. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
bartailedgodwit: A bar-tailed godwit wading: a long-legged shorebird with a very LONG SLIGHTLY UPTURNED BILL, pink at the base and dark at the tip, mottled brown and buff upperparts, a paler streaked breast, and long dark legs. Standing on both legs, body solid throughout. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
cyclops: A cyclops: a huge heavily-muscled giant with ONE SINGLE LARGE EYE in the centre of his forehead and no other eyes at all, a heavy brow, a thick beard, and sun-darkened skin. He carries a rough wooden club and wears a simple hide wrap. Standing full-figure, body solid and unbroken. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
piedavocet: A pied avocet: an elegant black-and-white wading bird with a very LONG THIN STRONGLY UPCURVED BLACK BILL, a black cap and nape, bold black wing panels on a white body, and long blue-grey legs. Standing on both legs, plumage solid and unbroken. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
mushussu: A mušḫuššu, the Babylonian dragon of the Ishtar Gate: a slender scaled serpent-dragon with a long neck, a narrow horned head with a forked tongue, the FORELEGS OF A LION and the HIND LEGS OF AN EAGLE with great talons, a scaly body and a long upright tail. Drawn in rich lapis blue and gold. Standing in side profile, body solid. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
panda_c: A giant panda CUB: a small round roly-poly baby panda with soft thick fur, the classic black eye patches, black ears, black shoulders and legs and a WHITE ROUND BODY that is one solid unbroken mass of fur. Short stubby limbs, oversized head, sitting up. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
peacockspider: A peacock spider: a tiny brilliantly coloured jumping spider seen from the FRONT, with ENORMOUS FORWARD-FACING ROUND BLACK EYES, and a raised fan-like abdomen flap patterned in vivid electric blue, red and orange stripes. Fuzzy pale legs held up in display. Body solid throughout. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
moonjelly: A moon jelly: a translucent pale bell-shaped jellyfish with FOUR HORSESHOE-SHAPED PINK-WHITE GONAD RINGS clearly visible through the top of the bell, a smooth domed bell edged with a fine fringe of short tentacles, and delicate trailing oral arms beneath. The bell reads as one continuous translucent dome. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
goat: A domestic goat standing in side profile: a sturdy goat with a shaggy white and brown coat, a beard under the chin, upright then backward-curving horns, rectangular pupils in amber eyes, and neat cloven hooves. THE HEAD AND FACE ARE COMPLETE AND SOLID, ears intact. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
honeyguide: A greater honeyguide perched: a small stout-billed bird with a plain grey-brown back, a paler grey breast, a short PINK BILL, a dark throat patch, and white outer tail feathers. Perched upright on a bare twig, body solid and unbroken throughout the breast and belly. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
proboscis: A proboscis monkey: a heavy-bodied reddish-brown monkey with a HUGE PENDULOUS DROOPING NOSE hanging down over its mouth, a pale grey-white belly and limbs, a pot belly, and a long pale tail. Sitting upright, body one solid mass. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
greatwhite: A great white shark in full side profile: a massive torpedo-shaped shark, SLATE GREY ABOVE and abruptly CHALK WHITE BELOW along a sharp dividing line, with a conical snout, black eyes, a tall triangular dorsal fin, long pectoral fins and a powerful crescent tail. Mouth slightly open showing triangular serrated teeth. Body solid throughout. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
greatdane: A great dane standing: a very tall long-legged short-coated dog with a narrow deep chest, a long rectangular head, floppy ears and a fawn coat with a black mask. THE CHEST AND BARREL ARE ONE SOLID UNBROKEN AREA. Standing square in side profile. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
badger_j: A badger CUB: a small young European badger with a stocky grey body, short legs, and the distinctive BLACK-AND-WHITE STRIPED FACE - a white head with two broad black stripes running from the nose back through each eye to the ear. Rounder and softer than an adult. Body solid throughout. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
